raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Adds `megatron.distributed_timeout_minutes` to `McoreEngineConfig` and passes it to `mpu.initialize_model_parallel`. Megatron-Core's process groups (NCCL and gloo) currently always get its default of 30 minutes. On large models, the first collective after a slow checkpoint load from a shared file system can exceed that and kill the job. The default `null` keeps the current behavior. The ref model follows the actor's value, since whichever engine initializes the process groups first sets their timeout.

Separately: `actor_rollout_ref.nccl_timeout` and `critic.nccl_timeout` (600 s) appear to be unused now. v0.6.0 passed them to `init_process_group`, but `engine_workers.py` calls `initialize_global_process_group_ray(timeout_second=None)`. This PR leaves them alone. Wiring them back up could be a follow-up; note that it would also shorten the default gloo timeout from 30 to 10 minutes.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+distributed_timeout_minutes and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+megatron+timeout
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

Added to `tests/workers/config/test_engine_config_on_cpu.py`:
- default is `None` and 90 is accepted;
- 0, -1, `True` and 1.5 are rejected;
- `MegatronEngine._init_device_mesh` passes `distributed_timeout_minutes=90` to `initialize_model_parallel` and omits it when unset (with `mpu` monkeypatched, so it runs on CPU).

`pytest tests/workers/config/test_engine_config_on_cpu.py`: 18 passed; 7 of them fail on `main`.

### API and Usage Example

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.distributed_timeout_minutes=90
critic.megatron.distributed_timeout_minutes=90
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/workers/config/engine.py`: new `McoreEngineConfig.distributed_timeout_minutes: Optional[int] = None`, validated in `__post_init__`.
- `verl/workers/engine/megatron/transformer_impl.py`: forwarded to `initialize_model_parallel` only when set.
- `verl/trainer/config/engine/megatron.yaml`, `verl/trainer/config/ref/megatron_ref.yaml`: new key (ref interpolates the actor's); `_generated_ppo_megatron_trainer.yaml` regenerated.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks.
- [x] Add / Update the documentation (config comments and docstring).
- [x] Add unit tests (CPU, picked up by `cpu_unit_tests.yml`).
- [ ] Request CI in the `ci-request` channel.
- [ ] Not related to `recipe`.

@@ -44,6 +44,34 @@ def test_offload_flags(self, offload_field):
         config = McoreEngineConfig(**{offload_field: True})
         assert getattr(config, offload_field) is True
 
+    def test_distributed_timeout_minutes(self):
+        assert McoreEngineConfig().distributed_timeout_minutes is None
+        assert McoreEngineConfig(distributed_timeout_minutes=90).distributed_timeout_minutes == 90
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [0, -1, True, 1.5])
+    def test_distributed_timeout_minutes_rejects_invalid(self, value):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="distributed_timeout_minutes"):
+            McoreEngineConfig(distributed_timeout_minutes=value)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("timeout", [None, 90])
+    def test_distributed_timeout_minutes_reaches_megatron(self, monkeypatch, timeout):
+        from verl.workers.engine.megatron import transformer_impl
+
+        calls = []
+        monkeypatch.setattr(transformer_impl.mpu, "is_initialized", lambda: False)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(transformer_impl.mpu, "initialize_model_parallel", lambda **kwargs: calls.append(kwargs))
+
+        engine = object.__new__(transformer_impl.MegatronEngine)
+        engine.engine_config = McoreEngineConfig(distributed_timeout_minutes=timeout)
+        engine._init_device_mesh()
+
+        assert len(calls) == 1
+        if timeout is None:
+            # Megatron-Core keeps its own default.
+            assert "distributed_timeout_minutes" not in calls[0]
+        else:
+            assert calls[0]["distributed_timeout_minutes"] == timeout
+
